verdict.rationale: Aider's own scripting docs show a first-party Python API: `Coder.create(...)` then `coder.run(...)` executes an instruction programmatically. That is a real, product-provided way to build against Aider, though the evidence shows only this one thin Python interface rather than a fully documented SDK. missing for 10: dedicated SDK documentation and API reference, SDKs for languages beyond Python, evidence of stability/versioning guarantees, independent hands-on corroboration of building on the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: # This will execute one instruction on those files and then return
coder.run("make a script that prints hello world")
